sp-08605.description_en: Allows the caster to research special imbedding spells to be used in creating items.

sp-08606.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a first level Essence spell in an item or potion.

sp-08607.description_en: Allows the caster to charge a wand that casts Essence spells (or has Essence abilities) back to its full number of charges.

sp-08608.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08609.description_en: Allows the caster make an imbedded first level spell (in an item) usable once per day. Note that the caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell in the item.

sp-08610.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a third level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08611.description_en: As Charge Wand, except rods (with Essence spells/abilities) can be charged.

sp-08612.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08613.description_en: As Daily I, except the item can have up to a third level spell that can be cast either three times per day (for a first level spell) or one time per day (for a second or third level spell).

sp-08614.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08615.description_en: As Charge Wand, except staves (with Essence spells/abilities) can be charged.

sp-08616.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a sixth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08617.description_en: As Daily I, except the item can have up to a fifth level spell that can be cast either four times per day (for a first level spell), three times per day (for a second level spell), two times per day (for a third level spell), or one time per day (for a fourth or fifth level spell).

sp-08618.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a seventh level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08619.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08621.description_en: As Daily True, except certain spells can be imbedded to operate constantly. See Section 7.4 for restrictions on what spells can be made constant.

sp-08622.description_en: As Imbed I, except any level spell can be imbedded (will only be castable once if the spell is over tenth level).

sp-08569.description_en: As Work Iron, except allows caster to work any inorganic mineral that would create an item with a +20 bonus (Mithril is an example of this).

sp-08570.description_en: As Work Iron, except caster can work any inorganic material that would make +25 items (Laen is a superhard volcanic glass that could be used in a world system to fit this description).

sp-08571.description_en: As Work Iron, except caster can work any inorganic material that would make +30 items. (Eog is an extremely dense, hard metal that is very difficult to work and find; it could be used to fit this description.)

sp-08572.description_en: Allows caster to make and work any metal, alloy, or inorganic mineral (e.g., Kregora is an alloy that has intense anti-Essence, anti-Channeling and anti-Mentalism properties, it could only be worked through the use of this spell).

sp-08573.description_en: Allows caster to work with non-magic liquids.

sp-08574.description_en: Allows caster to make one dose of a potion that can have a first level spell imbedded in it. The caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell into the potion.

sp-08576.description_en: As Work Liquid, except allows caster to work with nonmagic gas.

sp-08577.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08578.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a third level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08579.description_en: As Minor Poison, except works with all but the most deadly poisons.

sp-08581.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08583.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08586.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08589.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a twentieth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08590.description_en: Allows caster to research special imbedding spells to be used in creating items.

sp-08591.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a first level Mentalism or Channeling spell in an item or potion.

sp-08592.description_en: Allows the caster to charge a wand that casts Mentalism or Channeling spells (or has Mentalism or Channeling abilities) back to its full number of charges.

sp-08593.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08594.description_en: Allows the caster make an imbedded first level spell (in an item) usable once per day. Note that the caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell in the item.

sp-08595.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a third spell can be imbedded.

sp-08596.description_en: As Charge Wand, except rods (with Mentalism or Channeling spells/abilities) can be charged.

sp-08597.description_en: As Daily I, except the item can have up to a third level spell that can be cast either three times per day (for a first level spell) or one time per day (for a second or third level spell).

sp-08598.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08599.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08600.description_en: As Daily I, except the item can have up to a fifth level spell that can be cast either four times per day (for a first level spell), three times per day (for a second level spell), two times per day (for a third level spell), or one time per day (for a fourth or fifth level spell).

sp-08601.description_en: As Charge Wand, except staves (with Mentalism or Channeling spells/abilities) can be charged.

sp-08602.description_en: As Imbed I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08603.description_en: As Daily I, except the item can have up to a tenth level spell that can be cast either five times per day (for a first level spell), four times per day (for a second or third level spell), three times per day (for a fourth or fifth level spell), two times per day (for a sixth or seventh level spell), or one time per day (for an eighth, ninth, or tenth level spell).

sp-08604.description_en: As Daily True, except certain spells can be imbedded to operate constantly. See Section 7.4 for restrictions on what spells can be made constant.

sp-09376.description_en: Caster is able to determine the amount and type of elemental corruption within an item. If the item is cursed, the caster will know it is cursed but will not be able to tell what the nature of the curse is or how to remove it.

sp-09377.description_en: This spell allows a caster to memorize the taint patterns within an item. This is necessary to manipulate the corruption within an item.

sp-09378.description_en: Caster removes a single factor point from an item (caster chooses which one) changing it to a nonmanifesting factor point. This factor point is now free for use with other spells on this list.

sp-09379.description_en: Caster is able to change a nonmanifesting factor point to one of the desired type within an item. Subcategories are also chosen by the caster (e.g., the caster decides the item has a spell slot for a particular spell, instead of rolling randomly.) Total factor points in a factor may not be increased over 2 by the use of this spell.

sp-09380.description_en: Caster is able to predetermine one factor point in the item as it is being forged. This spell must be used in conjunction with the Elemental Forge spell list or it has no effect. This will cause the forging process to take as long as it would to cast this spell (i.e., 6 weeks). This spell will not prevent an item from being destroyed in the creation process.

sp-09381.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except the caster can remove up to two factor points from the item.

sp-09382.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to two non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 3 through the use of this spell.

sp-09383.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except the caster can remove up to three factor points from the item.

sp-09384.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to three non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 5 through the use of this spell.

sp-09388.description_en: As Remove Manifestation I, except caster can remove up to five factor points from the item.

sp-09389.description_en: As Add Manifestation I, except up to five non-manifesting factor points may be changed with this spell. Factor points for a specific factor may not be increased over 10 through the use of this spell.

sp-09390.description_en: Allows caster to force weapon's physical memory into an item that risks losing its physical form (i.e., an item of Air, Water, Light or Fire). By forcing the item to retain its physical memory, the item will retains its physical hardness while still manifesting the corruptive properties of the element. This spell must be cast on an item once a day for a week for the effects to become permanent.

sp-09391.description_en: As Favorable Manifestation I, except caster can predetermine up to four factor points.

sp-09392.description_en: As Favorable Manifestation II, except caster can predetermine up to five factors points.

sp-09393.description_en: Allows caster to create an elemental item with its capabilities restricted to two of the six factor options (chosen at the time of casting). All factors that the item gains will be split between the two chosen factors. Roll randomly for each factor point (equal chance for either factor.) This spell must be used in conjunction with the Elemental Forge spell list. Creation time is equal to one week per level of the Elemental Forge spell used.

sp-09394.description_en: Elemental material of the caster's main elemental type is pooled into a vessel for use with the Forge spells on this list. If the vessel has not been prepared with Prepare Tool, then the vessel will be destroyed by the elemental material and will risk damaging other equipment (effects are up to GM).

sp-09395.description_en: Prepares a tool or vessel for work with elemental material. The item will not corrode or suffer contamination while under the effects of this spell. Gloves are usually one of the first items protected by this spell. Anvils or furnaces cannot be protected by this spell.

sp-09396.description_en: As Prepare Tool, except this spell affects anvils.

sp-09398.description_en: When crafting metal items it allows caster to mix pooled element with his normal heat source. Combination stabilizes and forms an elemental flame that will burn for the next eight hours (if enough fuel is present). Flames' intensity is such that an item can be forged to have up to 20 corruption points. For organic items, this spell allows the caster to mix pooled elemental material with what is used to treat the organic object (tanning solution for leather, treatment oils for wood, etc.). See Forge Item II for further details.

sp-09399.description_en: Allows caster to forge elemental items with a +20 bonus to his forging/crafting skill. Items forged this way have an elemental corruption factor of up to 10. Re-forging the item using this spell and the appropriate spells on this list can raise the factor by 5 with a maximum of 20. Note: this spell does not ensure success, caster must make the appropriate crafting skill check. If failure occurs item is destroyed. All traits from this forging process are random. See the elemental corruption rules.

sp-09400.description_en: As Elemental Flame, except energy is more intense, allowing item to be corrupted up to a maximum of 40 corruption points.

sp-09401.description_en: Allows caster to destroy a elemental item in his forge with the associated magical explosion. Items up to 10 corruption points may be destroyed in this manner. Process takes one hour per corruption point; the hours need not be continuous.

sp-09402.description_en: As Forge Item II, except the initial rating of up to 15 with a maximum of rating of 30. Re-forging an item gives it another 6 corruption points.

sp-09403.description_en: Allows the caster to draw out half an elemental corruption point out of an item. This spell can be cast only once per day. If item's corruption level is dropped from a multiple of five to a lower number then one random trait is removed from the item (e.g., an item that had 30 corruption points was dropped to 29 by this spell, then one of the six traits the item had would be removed).

sp-09404.description_en: As Destroy Item I, except items with up to 20 corruption points may be safely destroyed.

sp-09405.description_en: As Forge Item II, except the initial rating may be up to 20 with a maximum rating of 40. Re-forging an item gives it another 7 corruption points.

sp-09406.description_en: As Elemental Flame, except energy is more intense, allowing item to be corrupted up to a maximum of 60 corruption points.

sp-09407.description_en: As Forge Item II, except the initial rating may be up to 30 with a maximum rating of 60. Re-forging an item gives it another 8 corruption points.

sp-09408.description_en: As Destroy Item I, except items with up to 30 corruption points may be safely destroyed.

sp-09409.description_en: As Draw Taint I, except that 1 corruption point is removed.

sp-09410.description_en: As Forge Item II, except the initial rating may be up to 40 with a maximum rating of 80. Re-forging an item gives it another 9 corruption points.

sp-09411.description_en: As Destroy Item I, except items with up to 40 corruption points may be safely destroyed.

sp-09412.description_en: As Elemental Flame, except that flame is very intense, allowing items to be corrupted up to a maximum of 100 corruption points.

sp-09413.description_en: As Forge Item II, except that initial rating may be 50 corruption points with a maximum rating of 100. Reforging an item gives it another 10 corruption points.

sp-09414.description_en: As Destroy Item I except that any elemental item may be destroyed as long as it is not an artifact.

sp-09037.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 5th level.

sp-09038.description_en: Allows the caster to attach an external body part (such as a hand, foot, etc.) to an assembled or living Amalgam in a one-hour operation. If the Surgery maneuver is successful and the target fails to resist this spell, then the appendage will function normally for the Amalgam.

sp-09040.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 10th level.

sp-09041.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach a limb to an Amalgam and the operation takes 2 hours.

sp-09042.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 10th level.

sp-09044.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach (or transplant) a sensory organ (such as an eye, tongue, ear, etc.) into an Amalgam and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09045.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 15th level.

sp-09047.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can transplant an internal organ (such as a heart, liver, lung) into an Amalgam and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09048.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 15th level.

sp-09049.description_en: As Graft Appendage, except the caster can attach or transplant a mechanical body part and the operation takes 3 hours.

sp-09050.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be up to 20th level.

sp-09051.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of up to 20th level.

sp-09052.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting Amalgam can be of any level.

sp-09053.description_en: As Compel Amalgam, except the caster can control an Amalgam of any level.

sp-09031.description_en: Caster can preserve one corpse (or a severed body part) from any deterioration and decay for the duration of this spell.

sp-09032.description_en: This spell analyzes one Amalgam, giving the caster in-depth information on how it was created and on its abilities. This translates into a +25 bonus to all maneuvers made by the caster to fashion an Amalgam of a similar nature.

sp-09033.description_en: Caster can convert a living person (of up to 3rd level) into a “Living” Amalgam of the same level or assemble (from body parts) an “assembled” Amalgam of up to 3rd level.

sp-09034.description_en: Caster can totally control an Amalgam of up to 3rd level. If the target is a “Living” Amalgam, then the duration of this spell is 1 hour per level of the caster and the range is 100' per level of the caster. If the target is an “assembled” Amalgam, then the duration of this spell is 1 day per level of the caster and the range is 1000' per level of the caster. If the Amalgam moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the Amalgam is free to act (including attacking the caster). When not acting on the caster's orders, the Amalgam Special Notes will wait idly by on the next command. 1.Many of the spells described here have a duration of “24

sp-09035.description_en: As Amalgam III, except the resulting hours”. For these spells, it is assumed that the caster must Amalgam can be up to 5th level. cast the spell once per day during the creation process

sp-09054.description_en: Caster can determine whether a specific device, machine, or vehicle in the area of effect is actually an Automaton. Caster can concentrate on a different 10'R area each round.

sp-09055.description_en: Allows the caster to create and imbue with magical energy a portable device whose mundane capabilities depend on muscle power, water or wind power, or clockwork. The result is a Device Automaton.

sp-09056.description_en: Allows the caster to create and imbue with magical energy a non-portable machine whose mundane capabilities depend on muscle power, water or wind power, or clockwork. The result is a Machine Automaton.

sp-09057.description_en: Allows the caster to create and imbue with magical energy a vehicle designed for surface land travel. The result is a Vehicle Automaton.

sp-09058.description_en: This spell analyzes one Automaton, giving the caster in-depth information on its operation and construction. This translates into a +25 bonus to all maneuvers made by the caster to operate this Automaton or to design and build an identical Automaton. Anyone to whom he describes the analysis receives a +10 bonus.

sp-09059.description_en: Allows the caster to add a Lesser Empowerment to a Device Automaton.

sp-09060.description_en: Allows the caster to add a Lesser Empowerment to a Machine Automaton.

sp-09061.description_en: As Enchant Land Vehicle, except the vehicle must be designed to fly or glide in atmosphere.

sp-09062.description_en: Allows the caster to add a Lesser Empowerment to a Vehicle Automaton.

sp-09063.description_en: The caster may restore 3d10 concussion hits of damage to an Automaton or repair one malfunction or replace one damaged part. A malfunction repair or replacement takes 10 minutes to take effect. Replacing a part requires a spare component.

sp-09064.description_en: As Enchant Device I, except the device may utilize steam power or electricity.

sp-09065.description_en: As Enchant Land Vehicle, except the vehicle must be designed to travel over water (but not underwater).

sp-09066.description_en: As Enchant Device I, except the machine may utilize steam power or electricity.

sp-09067.description_en: As Empower Device I, except the caster may add a Greater Empowerment.

sp-09068.description_en: As Empower Machine I, except the caster may add a Greater Empowerment.

sp-09070.description_en: As Empower Vehicle I, except the caster may add a Greater Empowerment.

sp-09072.description_en: The caster may double the effects of all Empowerments on a specific Automaton for the duration of this spell. Once this spell ends, an

sp-09073.description_en: The caster may restore 7d10 concussion hits of damage to an Automaton or repair all malfunctions or replace all damaged parts with spares. Any repairs or replacements take 10 minutes to take effect.

sp-09075.description_en: Allows the caster to add a True Empowerment to any type of Automaton.

sp-09076.description_en: Allows the caster to create and imbue with magical energy an Automaton (Device, Machine, or Vehicle), whose mundane capabilities depend on “advanced” (pseudo)scientific principles. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells described here have a duration of “24 hours”. For these spells, it is assumed that the caster must cast the spell once per day during the creation process (see also Spell Law, section 7.4.1) — the creations of these spell lists are permanent unless otherwise stated. 2.For details on the definitions and basic capabilities of Device, Machine, and Vehicle Automata, as well as appropriate Empowerments, please see Chapter 5.

sp-09085.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify whatever the target uses for manipulation (e.g. fingers, toes, claws, nails, webbing between digits, small tentacles).

sp-09086.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify miscellaneous external appendages (e.g. sex organs, stingers, rattles, web spinners, etc., but not hands or feet).

sp-09087.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify in shape or sensory range one sensory organ (e.g. eyes, ears, nose, etc.).

sp-09088.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any one (pair of) limb(s) (e.g. arm, leg, wing, tentacle, tail) or limb part (e.g. hand, foot, joint, etc.).

sp-09089.description_en: Caster can alter the overall size of a creature by one step (e.g. from Tiny to Small, Small to Medium, Medium to Large, Large to Huge, or vice versa).

sp-09090.description_en: Caster can add, remove or modify any one internal organ of the target (e.g. gills, glands, heart, lungs, poison sac, sex organs, spit, stomach) or affect the target internally (e.g. balance, blood type, bone density, fat layer, floatation, metabolism).

sp-09091.description_en: By casting this spell, the caster may make the next Change spell of 10th level or lower on this list affect the target and be inherited by all his/ her future progeny.

sp-09092.description_en: Caster can alter any one racial Resistance Roll modifier of the target by +5 or —5.

sp-09093.description_en: Caster can alter any one racial stat modifier of the target by +2 or —2.

sp-09094.description_en: If cast on two targets of the opposite sex, who then mate within the duration, the union will result in a fertile hybrid offspring, known as an Abomination. The targets may be of different species, but not of different “orders” (e.g. mammals, reptiles, fish, birds, etc.) e.g. using this spell, a lion may be mated with a horse, but a lion may not successfully mate with a crocodile. The result in form and statistics is at the GM's discretion.

sp-09095.description_en: Caster can make any target with animal instincts or no intelligence sentient (roll d100 for each mental stat). This spell has no effect on targets who are already sentient.

sp-09096.description_en: Caster can alter the target to any desired shape or form.

sp-09097.description_en: As Inherit Lesser Change, except any Change spell of 20th level or lower may be made permanent.

sp-09098.description_en: As Lesser Abomination, but the targets may be of any species.

sp-09099.description_en: As Greater Abomination, but the caster may choose the form and statistics (within limits) of the resulting hybrid.

sp-09077.description_en: Caster may magically study and store the form and nature of the target, if it fails to resist this spell. The caster must spend one minute in uninterrupted concentration after a successful casting in order to assimilate the information. Caster may only have as many targets stored as his temporary Memory stat (not stat bonus). Stored patterns may be released at any time.

sp-09078.description_en: This spell analyzes one Changeling, giving the caster in-depth information on how the changes were made and the nature of the changes (+25 to any maneuvers related to this knowledge). Even if the caster does not have the Changeling's original form stored, this spell gives the caster sufficient details to use the appropriate higher-level Change spell(s) to reverse the effects. Abominations cannot be reversed by this means.

sp-09079.description_en: Target's skin is altered (e.g. one change in hue, addition/removal of spots or stripes, one change in texture (oily, dry, scaly, leathery, metallic, etc.)).

sp-09080.description_en: Target's natural armor type can be raised or lowered by 1. Armor Type may not be reduced below 1 or raised above 20.

sp-09081.description_en: Caster can add, remove or modify one external bone projection of target (e.g. antlers, barbs, beaks, horns, talons, thorns, etc.). Special Notes

sp-09082.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any 1.See Chapter 8 for details on Changelings and Abomione piece of external cartilage of the target (e.g. antenna, ear, nations. nose, spikes, stalks, etc.). 2.All Change spells on this list require the caster to

sp-09083.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify any one concentrate for a number of rounds equal to the spell's external body part that covers another (e.g. eye lids, gill slots, level after casting for the spell to take permanent effect. neck and stomach pouches, feathers, fur, hair, whiskers, etc.). The caster must continue touching the target during this period. If either of these conditions is not met, the

sp-09084.description_en: Caster can add, remove, or modify parts of spell will fail and the effect will be undone. the target's mouth (e.g. snout, lips, teeth, fangs, suckers, tusks, tongue).

sp-09123.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a construct of creation level 1.

sp-09124.description_en: Caster is aware of any spirits trapped or possessing any constructs within range.

sp-09125.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 3 can be created and animated.

sp-09126.description_en: Allows the caster to expel one spirit of up to 5th level from a Construct.

sp-09127.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 5 can be created and animated.

sp-09128.description_en: Allows the caster to inscribe a symbol on a Construct of up to 10th level, which will prevent any spirit from possessing the entity without permission from its creator. Any spirit trapped within the Construct must obey the entity's creator and designated master. At casting, the caster must choose what will happen if the glyph is defaced: either the Construct will deanimate (until the Glyph is repaired) or the protection against possession is removed and any spirit already possessing the Construct is released from obedience to the entity's creator and master. It takes one round per creation level of the entity to inscribe the glyph.

sp-09129.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 7 can be created and animated.

sp-09130.description_en: Caster can restore 2d10 concussion hits to a Construct or reattach an undamaged body part to a Construct or repair a damaged body part, which is still attached to a Construct. A reattachment or repair takes 10 minutes to take effect.

sp-09131.description_en: As Purge Construct V, except one spirit of up to 10th level can be expelled.

sp-09132.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 10 can be created and animated.

sp-09133.description_en: Allows the caster to integrate one mechanical contraption into a Construct during the creation process.

sp-09134.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 12 can be created and animated.

sp-09135.description_en: Caster can restore 5d10 concussion hits to a Construct or reattach a damaged body part to a Construct, as long as all the bits are available. A reattachment takes 30 minutes to take effect.

sp-09136.description_en: As Purge Construct V, except one spirit of up to 20th level can be expelled.

sp-09137.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 15 can be created and animated.

sp-09138.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Construct of up to 20th level.

sp-09139.description_en: Allows the caster to replenish a Construct's supply of expendable materials. For non-magical materials, this spell will transmute and transform base materials (raw iron, water, etc.) into finished bolts and poisons inside the Construct. For magical materials, the spell will transform the material into the right forms and transfer them into the Construct.

sp-09140.description_en: Caster can restore all concussion hits to a Construct or unite a replacement body part to a Construct. Installing a replacement body part takes 1 hour to take effect.

sp-09141.description_en: As Purge Construct V, except one spirit of any level can be expelled.

sp-09142.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 20 can be created and animated.

sp-09143.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Construct of any level.

sp-09144.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of up to creation level 30 can be created and animated.

sp-09145.description_en: As Construct I, except constructs of any creation level can be created and animated. Special Notes: 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Construct's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete. 2.For more details on Construct creation, please see Chapter 6.

sp-09215.description_en: Caster is aware of any spirits trapped or possessing any golems within range.

sp-09216.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Wood Golem.

sp-09217.description_en: Allows the caster to expel one spirit of up to 5th level from a Golem.

sp-09218.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Water or an Ice Golem.

sp-09219.description_en: Allows the caster to inscribe a symbol on a Golem of up to 10th level, which will prevent any spirit from possessing the entity without permission from its creator. Any spirit trapped within the Golem must obey the entity's creator and designated master. At casting, the caster must choose what will happen if the glyph is defaced: either the Golem will deanimate (until the Glyph is repaired) or the protection against possession is removed and any spirit already possessing the Golem is released from obedience to the entity's creator and master. It takes one round per creation level of the entity to inscribe the glyph.

sp-09220.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from any organic materials, such as a Tar Golem, a Clay Golem, or a Bone Golem.

sp-09221.description_en: Caster can restore 2d10 concussion hits to a Golem or reattach an undamaged body part to a Golem or repair a damaged body part, which is still attached to a Golem. A reattachment or repair takes 10 minutes to take effect.

sp-09222.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Stone Golem.

sp-09223.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of up to 10th level can be expelled.

sp-09224.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from a single non-magical metal, excluding iron. This spell covers Copper Golems, Lead Golems, Silver Golems, and Gold Golems.

sp-09225.description_en: Caster can restore 5d10 concussion hits to a Golem or reattach a damaged body part to a Golem, as long as all the bits are available. A reattachment takes 30 minutes to take effect.

sp-09226.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from any non-magical alloy, excluding steel. This spell covers Brass Golems and Bronze Golems.

sp-09227.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of up to 20th level can be expelled.

sp-09228.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate an Iron Golem.

sp-09229.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Golem of up to 20th level.

sp-09230.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Crystal Golem.

sp-09231.description_en: Caster can restore all concussion hits to a Golem or unite a replacement body part to a Golem. Installing a replacement body part takes 1 hour to take effect.

sp-09232.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Steel Golem.

sp-09233.description_en: As Purge Golem V, except one spirit of any level can be expelled.

sp-09234.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem made from non-magical gems, excluding diamond. This spell covers Emerald Golems, Ruby Golems, and Sapphire Golems.

sp-09235.description_en: As Glyph of Control, except it can be applied to a Golem of any level.

sp-09236.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Diamond Golem.

sp-09237.description_en: Allows the caster to create and animate a Golem from any material, including magical metals, alloys and crystals. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Golem's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete. 2.For more details on Golem creation, please see Chapter 6.

sp-09284.description_en: Caster may determine and mentally store the mystical matrix of the target as well as learning the target's level, if the target fails to resist this spell. (The target will be aware that the caster has uses magic against him regardless of the RR outcome.) The caster must spend one minute in uninterrupted concentration after casting this spell to assimilate the information. Caster may only have as many matrices stored as his temporary Memory stat (not stat bonus). Matrices may be released at any time.

sp-09285.description_en: Caster can shape a Simulacrum into an animal or a plant form whose matrix he has previously stored using Simulacrum Matrix or enchant a vat to grow Simulacra of the chosen matrix.

sp-09286.description_en: Caster can create and animate a Simulacrum of up to 3rd level or enchant a vat to grow Simulacra of up to 3rd level.

sp-09287.description_en: This spell analyzes one Simulacrum, giving the caster in-depth information on how it was made (which Simulacrum #, Matrix, and Warp Matrix # spells were used and any special components) and the nature of its abilities.

sp-09288.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 5th level.

sp-09289.description_en: Caster can make one Minor alteration to a Simulacrum's matrix during its creation.

sp-09290.description_en: The caster may transfer the soul of a willing target into a Simulacrum of equivalent level that was created using the target's blood. Once in the Simulacrum, the target has access to all his skills, spells, and other abilities. The original body falls into a coma and will eventually die.

sp-09291.description_en: This spell allows a natural ability (chosen by the caster at time of casting) possessed by the blood donor of the Simulacrum to manifest in the Simulacrum. Such abilities include senses, movement abilities, natural resistances, ranks in Power Point Development (limited to the lesser of the Simulacrum's level or the donor's number of ranks), Talents, etc. The spell allows the Simulacrum to use the ability.

sp-09292.description_en: Target Simulacrum is healed of 5d10 concussion hits or up to 5 hits per round of bleeding damage or one damaged or severed muscle or tendon is healed. Recovery time for muscle or tendon damage is 1 day.

sp-09293.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 10th level.

sp-09294.description_en: As Animal/Plant Matrix, except the Simulacrum may be shaped into a sentient (normally humanoid) form or the vat is designed for similar forms.

sp-09295.description_en: As Awaken Ability, except allows one single skill known by the blood donor (chosen by the caster at time of casting) to be manifested by the Simulacrum (with the lesser of ranks equal to the Simulacrum's level or half the number of ranks possessed by the donor, rounding down).

sp-09296.description_en: As Warp Matrix I, except the caster may make one Lesser alteration.

sp-09297.description_en: Target Simulacrum is healed of any one broken (not shattered) bone or joint. Recovery time of 1-10 days is required.

sp-09298.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 15th level.

sp-09299.description_en: As Awaken Skill, except allows one single spell list (or spell-like ability) known by the blood donor (chosen by the caster at time of casting) to be manifested by the Simulacrum. If this is a spell list, then the Simulacrum gains the lesser of ranks equal to the Simulacrum's level or

sp-09300.description_en: As Animal/Plant Matrix, except the Simulacrum may be shaped into a beast form (e.g. monster, unnatural creature, or sentient plant) or the vat is designed for one such form.

sp-09301.description_en: As Warp Matrix I, except the caster may make one Greater alteration.

sp-09302.description_en: Target Simulacrum is healed of any one shattered bone or joint or one damaged nerve or one damaged external or internal organ. In all cases, a recovery time of 1-10 days is required.

sp-09303.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 20th level.

sp-09304.description_en: The caster may command a Simulacrum of any level, even if the caster is not its blood donor. The caster must concentrate for one round to give or cancel an order, but need not maintain concentration to ensure the order is undertaken. The simulacrum will continue to obey the order until it is accomplished or cancelled or the spell's duration ends. If the Simulacrum moves beyond the spell's range of the caster, the spell ends. If the Simulacrum receives orders from its creator / blood donor in the same round as it receives an order from the caster, the Entity may make a new RR. Success terminates this spell.

sp-09305.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be up to 30th level.

sp-09306.description_en: As Simulacrum III, except the Simulacrum or vat can be of any level.

sp-09100.description_en: Allows the caster to store the parameters of any one spell cast within the next minute for use in later imbedding. Thereafter, the creator may cast the Research spell (at a power point cost of one plus the level of the imbedded spell) instead of the imbedded spell itself. A caster may only have one spell's parameters stored in a Research spell at any given time (but may choose to replace the stored spell at any time.)

sp-09101.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell of any realm into an artificial entity.

sp-09102.description_en: Allows caster to charge an entity with 20 charges of any spell (imbedded using an Imbed spell).

sp-09103.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell (using an Imbed spell) that can be cast once per day.

sp-09104.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09105.description_en: Allows caster to imbed a 1st-level spell (using an Imbed spell) so that it functions either constantly or “at will”.

sp-09106.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 3 times per day; a 2nd or 3rd, once per day.

sp-09107.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09108.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 50 charges.

sp-09109.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 3rd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09110.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09111.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 5 times per day; a 2nd, twice per day; a 3rd, 4th, or 5th, once per day.

sp-09112.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 100 charges.

sp-09114.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 5th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09116.description_en: As Minor Charged Power, except the entity receives 200 charges.

sp-09117.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09118.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd, 5 times per day; a 3rd, 3 times per day; a 4th or 5th, twice per day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th, once per day.

sp-09119.description_en: As Imbed I, except 1st through 20th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09122.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 20th level spells can be imbedded. Special Notes

sp-09212.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-09213.description_en: As Daily Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded; a 1st level spell could be cast 10 times per day; a 2nd, 5 times per day; a 3rd, 3 times per day; a 4th or 5th, twice per day; a 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th or 10th, once per day.

sp-09214.description_en: As Constant Power I, except 1st through 10th level spells can be imbedded. Special Notes 1.Many of the spells on this spell list have a duration of 24 hrs — the creation process requires that these spells be cast once per day during entity creation and gives the caster the ability to enchant entities for a whole day. The Golem's animation is permanent once the creation process is complete.

sp-09261.description_en: Caster grants a measure of rudimentary reasoning to the entity. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 11 to 30. After the spell is cast, roll a d20 and add 10 (D20+10) separately to determine Re and Me stats randomly. If the caster's Memory or Reasoning stats are lower than the randomly generated stats, then use the caster's stats instead. The entity will be able to follow simple orders (e.g. single sentences of ten words or less), but will have no ability for independent thinking.

sp-09262.description_en: Caster grants the entity the ability to understand a specific language. The number of ranks in both written and spoken forms is equal to the ranks possessed by the caster. The entity cannot actually speak using this spell.

sp-09263.description_en: Caster imparts up to five category ranks of a single chosen skill category to the entity.

sp-09264.description_en: Caster imparts up to five skill ranks of a single chosen skill to the entity. Ranks in spell lists, Power Point Development, Body Development and language skills may not be imbedded.

sp-09265.description_en: Caster can extend the duration of the next spell cast from this list onto an entity to 1 day per level of the caster.

sp-09266.description_en: The entity's eyes record all that it sees during the duration of this spell for playback later (the caster need only look into their eyes).

sp-09267.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to ten category ranks.

sp-09268.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to ten skill ranks.

sp-09269.description_en: As Low Sentience, except the caster grants a greater measure of rudimentary reasoning to the entity. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 33 to

sp-09270.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 week per level of the caster.

sp-09271.description_en: As Visual Recording, except that the entity's ears can record any sounds that it hears during the duration of this spell for playback later (the caster need only touch their ears to hear the sounds himself.)

sp-09272.description_en: Caster grants the entity the ability to speak any languages to understand. Golem voices are low and rumbling; Construct voices sound hollow.

sp-09273.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to fifteen category ranks.

sp-09274.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to fifteen skill ranks.

sp-09275.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 month per level of the caster.

sp-09276.description_en: The caster grants the entity a measure of willpower and personality. This takes the form of either Self Discipline, Intuition, Empathy and Presence stats with a range of values from 33 to 69 (roll 4d10 and add 29 (4D10+29) to determine each stat randomly) or one of Self Discipline, Intuition, Empathy and Presence stats with a range of values from 70 to 89 (roll d20 and add 69 (D20+69) to determine the chosen stat). This spell can be cast multiple times. If the caster's equivalent stat is lower than the randomly generated stat, use the caster's stat instead.

sp-09277.description_en: As Medium Sentience, except the caster grants the entity the ability of independent thinking. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats with a range of values from 70 to 89. After the spell is cast, roll d20 and add 69 (D20+69) separately to determine Re and Me stats randomly. The entity will thus be able to improvise solutions by adapting previously received orders to new situations.

sp-09278.description_en: As Imbed Category V, except the caster imparts up to twenty category ranks.

sp-09279.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to twenty skill ranks.

sp-09280.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 1 year per level of the caster.

sp-09281.description_en: As High Sentience, except the caster grants the entity a high degree of intelligence. This takes the form of Memory and Reasoning stats

sp-09282.description_en: As Imbed Skill V, except the caster imparts up to thirty skill ranks.

sp-09283.description_en: As Extension I, except the duration is 10 years per level of the caster. Special Notes 1.This list boosts the intellect of a Golem or Construct by sharing the caster's intelligence and skills. Once the enhancing spell duration ends, the entity reverts to its previous degree of intelligence and skill. 2.For Sentience and Entity Will spells, the relevant stats of the caster determine the maximum stat attainable by the entity. The entity is drawing directly on the caster's intellect and so cannot be smarter than the caster. 3.For Imbed Category and Imbed Skill spells, the caster must possess the necessary category or skill ranks that he wishes to impart to the entity. Thus an alchemist with only 7 ranks in Heraldry could only impart 7 ranks to a Golem using an Imbed Skill X or higher spell. If the same alchemist had no ranks in Tactics, then she would be unable to give her Golem any ranks in that skill.

sp-09146.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any demon within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, and then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09147.description_en: The caster learns the type, home plane, and nature of a given Demon.

sp-09148.description_en: The caster can summon one Type I Demon. The caster has no control over what specific kind of Type I Demon is conjured. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the Demon nor any control over the Demon through this spell.

sp-09149.description_en: The caster can banish one Type I Demon back to its natural plane of existence. The Demon may make a Resistance Roll against this effect.

sp-09150.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a Type I Demon into a Golem or a Construct within 10' of the caster. The demon may make a Resistance Roll to prevent this. Once imbedded, the Golem or Construct will spontaneously manifest one or more Demonic Powers (see notes below).

sp-09151.description_en: The caster may totally control one Type I Demon. The Demon receives an initial Resistance Roll to resist this spell's effects. If the Demon is not imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 5 minutes per level of the caster, and the range is 100'. If the Demon moves outside this 100' range, then it becomes free to attack the caster and/or return to its natural plane of existence. If the Demon is (later) imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 4 hours per level of the caster and the range is 300' per level of the caster. If the Golem or Construct moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the

sp-09152.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand Demons.

sp-09153.description_en: As Summon Demon I, except the caster can summon a Type II Demon.

sp-09154.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except the caster can banish a Type II Demon.

sp-09155.description_en: As Imbed Demon I, except that the caster can imbed a Type II (or lower) Demon.

sp-09156.description_en: As Compel Demon I, except the caster can control a Type II Demon.

sp-09157.description_en: As Summon Demon I, except the caster can summon a Type III Demon.

sp-09158.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except the caster can banish a Type III Demon.

sp-09159.description_en: As Imbed Demon I, except that the caster can imbed a Type III (or lower) Demon.

sp-09160.description_en: As Compel Demon I, except the caster can control a Type III Demon.

sp-09161.description_en: As Summon Demon I, except the caster can summon a Type IV Demon.

sp-09162.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except the caster can banish a Type IV Demon.

sp-09163.description_en: As Imbed Demon I, except that the caster can imbed a Type IV (or lower) Demon.

sp-09164.description_en: As Compel Demon I, except the caster can control a Type IV Demon.

sp-09165.description_en: As Summon Demon I, except the caster can summon either one random Type V Demon or one random Type VI Demon or one specific Type I-IV Demon.

sp-09166.description_en: As Banish Demon I, except the caster can banish a Type V or a Type VI Demon.

sp-09167.description_en: As Imbed Demon I, except that the caster can imbed a Type VI (or lower) Demon.

sp-09168.description_en: As Compel Demon I, except the caster can control a Type V or Type VI Demon. If this spell is used on an imbedded Demon of Type IV or less, the duration of the compulsion is extended to one day per level of the caster and the range becomes 1000' per level of the caster. Special Notes: 1.The Demons conjured by this list should normally be limited to Demons from the First to Sixth Pale, Demons of the Void, and other Demon entities. Caster should not be permitted to summon other extra-planar creatures using this list. See section 7.2.4 for further details and tables to randomly determine which Demon is summoned by a particular spell. 2.Demonic Powers are classified as Demonic Minor Powers, Demonic Lesser Powers, Demonic Greater Powers, and Demonic Major Powers. The nature and numbers of powers manifested by an imbedded Demon is random, but the range is constrained by the Type of the Demon and the level of the Imbed Demon # spell. More powerful Demons have greater potential powers; likewise imbedding a less powerful demon with a more potent imbedding spell yields greater abilities.

sp-09169.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any elemental within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09170.description_en: The caster learns the type and nature of a given Elemental.

sp-09171.description_en: The caster can banish one Class A Elemental back to its natural plane of existence. The Elemental may make a Resistance Roll. See Special Notes for definitions of Class A, B, C, and D Elementals.

sp-09172.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a Class A Elemental of a type chosen by the caster prior to the casting of this spell. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the Elemental nor any control over the Elemental through this spell.

sp-09173.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a Class A Elemental into a Golem, or a Construct within 10' of the caster. The Elemental may make a Resistance Roll to prevent this.

sp-09174.description_en: The caster may totally control one Class A Elemental. The Elemental receives an initial Resistance Roll to resist this spell's effects. If the Elemental is not imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 minute per level of the caster, and the range is 100'. If the Elemental moves outside this 100' range, then it becomes free to attack the caster and/or return to its natural plane of existence. If the Elemental is imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 hour per level of the caster and the range is 100' per level of the caster. If the Golem or Construct moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the Elemental is free to act (including attacking the caster) — however the imbedded Elemental cannot leave the body of the entity. When not acting on the caster's orders, the Elemental will wait idly by on the next command.

sp-09175.description_en: If cast on an entity with an imbedded Elemental of any Class, one random Elemental Minor Power can be triggered. Only one Manifest Element spell can be active on any entity at any one time.

sp-09176.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand Elementals.

sp-09177.description_en: As Elemental Banish I, except the caster can banish one Class B Elemental.

sp-09178.description_en: If cast within one minute prior to casting a Compel spell from this spell list on an elemental imbedded within a Golem or Construct, it increases the duration to 1 day per level of the caster and the range to 1000' per level of the caster. This has no effect on a Compel spell used to control a non-imbedded Elemental.

sp-09179.description_en: As Elemental Summons I, except the caster can summon a Class B Elemental.

sp-09180.description_en: As Elemental Imbed I, except the caster can imbed a Class B Elemental.

sp-09181.description_en: As Elemental Compel I, except the caster can control a Class B Elemental.

sp-09182.description_en: As Manifest Element I, except either two random Elemental Minor Powers or one random Elemental Lesser Power can be triggered. A Class B Elemental must be imbedded to trigger a Lesser Power.

sp-09183.description_en: As Elemental Banish I, except the caster can banish one Class C Elemental.

sp-09184.description_en: As Elemental Summons I, except the caster can summon a Class C Elemental.

sp-09185.description_en: As Elemental Imbed I, except the caster can imbed a Class C Elemental.

sp-09186.description_en: As Elemental Compel I, except the caster can control a Class C Elemental.

sp-09187.description_en: As Manifest Element I, except either three random Elemental Minor Powers or two random Elemental Lesser Powers or one random Elemental Greater Power can be triggered. A Class B (or higher) Elemental must be imbedded to trigger a Lesser Power; a Class C (or higher) must be imbedded to trigger a Greater Power.

sp-09188.description_en: As Extend Compel I, except the duration is now 1 week per level of the caster and the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-09189.description_en: As Elemental Summons I, except the caster can summon a Class D Elemental.

sp-09190.description_en: As Elemental Imbed I, except the caster can imbed a Class D Elemental.

sp-09191.description_en: As Manifest Element I, except either four random Elemental Minor Powers or three random Elemental Lesser Powers or two random Elemental Greater Powers or one random Elemental Major Power can be triggered. A Class B (or higher) Elemental must be imbedded to trigger a Lesser Power; a Class C (or higher) to trigger ., must .,be imbedded ., ., .,a Greater Power; a Class D must be imbedded to trigger a Major Power. sp-09238.description_en: Caster can identify either one skill or one spell list or one ability possessed by the target. The caster learns the number of skill ranks, the ranks known in the spell list, or the approximate power level of the ability, as appropriate.

sp-09239.description_en: This spell is used in two modes — the first temporarily weakens the association between body and life essence, the second actually transfers the disassociated life essence from one body or vessel to another. When successfully cast in the first mode, the target will feel a wrenching sensation as the disassociation takes place. If the spell is successfully recast within two minutes, the caster may transfer the target's life essence into any chosen Life Essence Vessel or physical body (which does not already have a possessing life essence). The target's original body falls into a coma. If the second casting does not take place or succeed within the two minutes, the target's life essence rejoins his body, and the process must begin again from scratch. Targets receive a special +25 bonus to all Resistance Rolls against this spell. Only animals, beings, and “beasts” may be affected by this spell (see notes below).

sp-09240.description_en: This spell allows an imbedded life essence to “translate” its natural instincts and learned behavior (e.g. ability to walk) into the ability to use all the facilities of an artificial body. This spell has the side-effect of making artificial bodies seem “natural” to animals and beasts, if they have been imbedded in an equivalent or very similar form, e.g. an imbedded Wolf essence will feel “normal” in a Wolf Construct or Wolf Golem.

sp-09241.description_en: This spell allows a natural ability (chosen by the caster at time of casting) of the imbedded life essence to manifest in an artificial body. Such abilities include senses, movement abilities, natural resistances, Power Points, Talents, etc., possessed by the life essence in its original body. The spell allows the life essence to use the ability in its artificial body.

sp-09242.description_en: The caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 5th level into a Golem or Construct. The life essence must previously have been transferred into the entity's body.

sp-09243.description_en: As Manifest Ability, except allows one single skill known by the imbedded life essence (chosen by the caster at time of casting) to be manifested in the artificial body, enabling the life essence to effectively use the skill in its new body.

sp-09244.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an intelligent (humanoid) being of up to 5th level into a Golem or Construct.

sp-09245.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast (monster, unnatural creature, or sentient plant) of up to 5th level into a Golem or Construct.

sp-09246.description_en: Caster can preserve a body which has had its life essence transferred out from it, preventing any deterioration in stats and physical condition, and removing the need for food, water and air. The body may still be destroyed by violence during the duration of the spell. If the life essence is not returned to the body before the spell ends, the normal process of death will resume as soon as the spell ends.

sp-09247.description_en: As Manifest Skill, except allows one single spell list (or spell-like ability) known by the imbedded life essence (chosen by the caster at time of casting) to be manifested in the artificial body, enabling the life essence to effectively use the spells in its new body.

sp-09248.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 10th level.

sp-09249.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 10th level.

sp-09250.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 10th level.

sp-09251.description_en: As Body Stasis I, except the duration of the stasis is one week per level of the caster.

sp-09252.description_en: Caster can prevent a life essence transferred out of its own body but not imbedded in an artificial body from dissipating out of its current container for the duration of this spell.

sp-09253.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 15th level.

sp-09254.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 15th level.

sp-09255.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 15th level.

sp-09256.description_en: As Body Stasis I, except the duration of the stasis is one week per level of the caster.

sp-09257.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal of up to 20th level.

sp-09258.description_en: As Imbed Being Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a being of up to 20th level.

sp-09259.description_en: As Imbed Beast Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from a beast of up to 20th level.

sp-09260.description_en: As Imbed Animal Essence V, except the caster may imbed the life essence from an animal, being, or beast of any level. Special Notes 1.See section 7.2.5 for a full treatment of how this spell list should be used.

sp-09307.description_en: Allows the caster to detect any spirit within the area of effect of the spell. The caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09308.description_en: The caster learns the type of a given Spirit as well as its power level.

sp-09309.description_en: Gives the caster the ability to speak with and understand Spirits.

sp-09310.description_en: The caster can banish one spirit of up to 5th level back to the Spirit world. The Spirit may make a Resistance Roll.

sp-09311.description_en: Caster learns the number of taint levels possessed by a given Spirit.

sp-09312.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a spirit of up to 5th level of a type chosen by the caster prior to the casting of this spell. The caster is not granted the ability to converse with the spirit nor any control over the Spirit through this spell. The Spirit will appear before the caster as a wavering form.

sp-09313.description_en: Allows the caster to imbed a Spirit of up to 5th level into a Golem or a Construct within 10' of the caster. The Spirit may make a Resistance Roll to prevent this.

sp-09314.description_en: The caster may totally control one Spirit of up to 5th level. The Spirit receives an initial Resistance Roll to resist this spell's effects. If the Spirit is not imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 minute per level of the caster, and the range is 100'. If the Spirit moves outside this 100' range, then it becomes free to attack the caster and/or return to the Spirit world. If the Spirit is imbedded in a Golem or a Construct, then the duration of this spell is 1 hour per level of the caster and the range is 100' per level of the caster. If the Golem or Construct moves beyond this range or the spell expires, then the Spirit is free to act (including attacking the caster) — however the imbedded Spirit cannot leave the body of the entity. When not acting on the caster's orders, the Spirit will wait idly by on the next command.

sp-09315.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09316.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09317.description_en: The caster may purify up to one taint level per caster level from a given Spirit. Each level of taint that a Spirit has gives it a special bonus of +5 to its Resistance Roll.

sp-09318.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09319.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of up to 10th level.

sp-09320.description_en: If cast within one minute prior to casting a Compel Spirit spell on a spirit imbedded within a Golem or Construct, it increases the duration to 1 day per level of the caster and the range to 1000' per level of the caster. This has no effect on a Compel Spirit spell used to control a disembodied Spirit.

sp-09321.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09322.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09323.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09324.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of up to 20th level.

sp-09325.description_en: As Banish Spirit V, except the caster can banish one Spirit of any level.

sp-09326.description_en: As Summon Spirit V, except the caster can summon one Spirit of any level.

sp-09327.description_en: As Extend Compel I, except the duration is now 1 week per level of the caster and the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-09328.description_en: As Imbed Spirit V, except the caster can imbed one Spirit of any level.

sp-09329.description_en: As Compel Spirit V, except the caster can control one Spirit of any level. Special Notes 1.See chapter 7 for details on imbedding Spirits, types of Spirits, taint levels, etc.

sp-09330.description_en: Caster can detect the presence of any Amalgam, Simulacrum, or Changeling in the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09331.description_en: The target Amalgam is held to 25% of normal action. The entity may act normally in any round when the caster is not concentrating on this spell. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09332.description_en: As Hold Amalgam, except affects one Simulacrum.

sp-09333.description_en: The caster gains a detailed insight into the nature and powers of an Amalgam. Specifically, the caster learns the Amalgam's level, animating Spirit type (if any), abilities, and grafted body parts (for living Amalgams only).

sp-09334.description_en: The caster gains a detailed insight into the nature and powers of a Simulacrum. Specifically, the caster learns the Simulacrum's level, matrix type and modifications, natural and supernatural abilities, and any abilities, skills, or spell lists triggered by an Awaken spell.

sp-09335.description_en: The caster gains a detailed insight into the nature of any Changes made to a Changeling, and whether they are inheritable by future offspring. This spell will also identify the nature and parentage of hybrids created by Abomination spells or Inherit Lesser Change or Inherit Greater Change.

sp-09336.description_en: Caster can determine the direction and distance to any one Amalgam, Simulacrum, or Changeling previously analyzed by an Identify Amalgam, Identify Simulacrum, or Identify Changeling spell.

sp-09339.description_en: Caster can reverse the effect of one Change spell (of up to 5th-level) from the Changeling spell list from the target. This also prevents the change from being inherited by future offspring.

sp-09340.description_en: Caster can prevent a grafted body part being used to control a living Amalgam. The target retains use of the grafted body part.

sp-09341.description_en: Allow the caster to temporarily annul the effects of one Awaken Ability or one Awaken Spell or one Awaken Skill spell on the target Simulacrum.

sp-09342.description_en: Caster can identify the creator (and blood donor, if any) of one Amalgam, Simulacrum, or Changeling.

sp-09343.description_en: As Trace Abomination I, except the range is 1000' per level of the caster.

sp-09344.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except one Change of up to 10th-level can be reversed.

sp-09347.description_en: As Suppress Awakened, except for the shorter range and the permanent duration.

sp-09348.description_en: As Suppress Graft, except the duration is permanent.

sp-09349.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except one Change of up to 15th-level can be reversed.

sp-09352.description_en: As Restore Changeling V, except all Changes of any level can be reversed.

sp-09353.description_en: Caster can detect the presence of any Golem or Construct in the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different area each round. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09354.description_en: Caster learns the location of any Glyph of Control on the target's body.

sp-09355.description_en: The target entity is held to 25% of normal action. The entity may act normally in any round when the caster is not concentrating on this spell. The caster may stop concentrating, then resume at a later time, as long as the spell is still active.

sp-09356.description_en: The caster gains a detailed insight into the nature and powers of a Golem or Construct. Specifically, the caster learns the entity's creation level, physical composition, modifications (i.e. deviations from standard entities of that type), mechanical abilities (if any), and magical abilities (if any). The caster does not learn any details relating to any imbedded spirit or powers manifested by that essence or benefits granted by spells from the Sentience spell list.

sp-09357.description_en: The caster may command an Entity of up to 5th level (see notes below). The caster must concentrate for one round to give or cancel an order, but need not maintain concentration to ensure the order is undertaken. The entity will continue to obey the order until it is accomplished or cancelled or the spell's duration ends. If the Entity moves beyond 20' per level of the caster, this spell terminates immediately. If the Entity receives orders from either its

sp-09358.description_en: The caster gains a detailed insight into the nature and powers of any essence residing or imbedded in a Golem or Construct. Specifically, the caster learns the essence's exact type (type of Demon, Elemental, Spirit or identity of a Life Essence) and level, and any powers or abilities manifested by the essence (if any). The caster also learns if the Entity is receiving any benefits granted by spells from the Sentience spell list.

sp-09359.description_en: The caster can expel an imbedded or inhabiting essence of up to 10th-level from an Entity.

sp-09360.description_en: Caster temporarily annuls the effects of a Glyph of Control on an Entity, which either deanimates or releases the Entity (and resident essence) from obedience to its creator/master as specified by the original Glyph caster.

sp-09361.description_en: The Entity cannot use one of its Charged, Daily or Constant Magical Powers for the duration of this spell. (This only counters spell abilities from the Golem Magic and Construct Magic spell lists.) Caster chooses which power is restrained.

sp-09362.description_en: Allows the caster to wrest permanent control of an Entity of up to 10th level from its current master (if any). If the Entity fails its RR, caster can choose to become the Entity's master or may designate another individual as its master within 20'. The Entity's relationship with its creator is unchanged.

sp-09363.description_en: Allow the caster to temporarily annul one chosen enhancement from the Sentience spell list, e.g. all imbedded categories, skills or languages or the effects of a Sentience or an Entity Will spell.

sp-09364.description_en: As Command Entity I, except the caster may command artificial entities of up to 20th level.

sp-09365.description_en: Allow the caster to temporarily annul one chosen enhancement from the Life Essence spell list, i.e. the effects of one Manifest Ability or one Manifest Skill or one Manifest Spell spell.

sp-09366.description_en: Allows the caster to temporarily annul one chosen Demonic or Elemental Power.

sp-09367.description_en: As Purge Entity I, except the caster may expel essences of up to 20th level.

sp-09368.description_en: As Nullify Glyph, except that the Glyph of Control is permanently removed.

sp-09369.description_en: As Nullify Sentience, except that the chosen enhancement is permanently removed.

sp-09370.description_en: As Nullify Manifestation, except that the chosen manifested ability is permanently removed.

sp-09371.description_en: As Nullify Empowerment, except that the chosen enpowerment is permanently removed.

sp-09372.description_en: As Transfer Mastery I, except affects artificial entities of up to 20th level.

sp-09373.description_en: As Command Entity I, except the caster may command artificial entities of any level.

sp-09374.description_en: As Purge Entity I, except the caster may expel essences of any level.

sp-09375.description_en: As Transfer Mastery I, except affects artificial entities of any level. Special Notes 1.The spells on this list affect all types of Golems and Constructs. 2.The level of an Entity for Command Entity # and Transfer Mastery # spells is either the Entity's creation
